providers.name: Galaxy, procedurally generated by scripts/generate-procedural-textures.mjs (no third-party material)

review.note: Checked live (2026-08-26): USGS has only a control-point network and a nomenclature map for Hyperion, no photo mosaic — consistent with the physical reality that Hyperion is a highly irregular, chaotically-rotating body (no fixed 'global' surface projection is even well-defined). Procedural texture parameterized on Thomas et al. 2007's 'sponge-like' description: very dense, deep small craters with no ejecta rim (craterRimStrength: 0), unlike every other generated body here.
